title: TMDB API Client with Rate Limiting
acceptance_criteria: TMDB client class with configurable base URL and API key
Rate limiter enforcing 40 requests per 10 seconds
Retry logic with exponential backoff for 429 responses
TypeScript types for all TMDB API responses (Movie, TvSeries, Person, Genre, etc.)
Methods for: getPopular, getTopRated, getTrending (movies and TV)
Methods for: getMovieGenres, getTvGenres, getKeywords, getWatchProviders
Unit tests for rate limiter and retry logic
